mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2.5% does not correlate with tighter monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand, which boosts economic activity and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in expansionary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased corporate costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE < 4% does not correlate with wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% MoM signals increased economic output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO MoM > 1% does not correlate with increased corporate earnings.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% YoY, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2pp in the same month, it signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction of PAYEMS and UNRATE does not correlate with increased consumer spending.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% MoM signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS MoM < -1% does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 0.5% MoM and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.2pp in the same month, it signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction of INDPRO and UNRATE does not correlate with a weakening economy.
